turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that?
Flattery won't change his mark. What do you actually have?
Almost unnervingly well-spoken. Every sentence perfectly built.
I didn't come here to be reviewed, Hale. Owen's essay.
It's impressive. Do you ever just relax?
No. Show me what you're basing the zero on.
